        for _ in range(17):
            s.append(alphabet[n % 36]); n //= 36
        return prefix + "_" + "".join(s)

    def _canon_sha256(obj):
        try:
            s = json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
        except TypeError:
            return None
        return hashlib.sha256(s.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    def _match_table_id(tid, tables_rows):
        if not isinstance(tid, str) or not tid:
            return False
        if re.match(r"^ddb_tbl_[0-9A-Z]{17}$", tid):
            return True
        return any(isinstance(t, dict) and t.get("table_id") == tid for t in tables_rows)

    def _append_log(op_logs, account_id_val, table_id_val, response_obj, ok, err_code=None, err_msg=None, rcu=0.0, wcu=0.0, http_status=None):
        op_logs.append({
            "op_id": _new_id("ddb_op"),
            "account_id": account_id_val if isinstance(account_id_val, str) and account_id_val else "unknown",
            "table_id": table_id_val,
            "index_id": None,
            "tool_name": "update_item",
            "request": {
                "table_id": table_id, "pk_s": pk_s, "pk_n": pk_n, "pk_b": pk_b,
                "sk_s": sk_s, "sk_n": sk_n, "sk_b": sk_b,
                "attributes": attributes, "expected_version": expected_version, "return_values": return_values
            },
            "response": response_obj,
            "http_status": http_status,
            "consumed_read_units": float(rcu),
            "consumed_write_units": float(wcu),
            "duration_ms": max(0, int((time.time() - _t0) * 1000)),
            "status": "SUCCEEDED" if ok else "FAILED",
            "error_code": err_code,
            "error_message": err_msg,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        })

    op_logs = _load("ddb_operation_logs.json")
    tables = _load("ddb_tables.json")
    items = _load("ddb_items.json")

    if not _match_table_id(table_id, tables):
        er = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "table_id does not match expected format", field="table_id")
        _append_log(op_logs, "unknown", table_id, er, False, err_code="ValidationException", err_msg=er["error"]["message"])
        _save("ddb_operation_logs.json", op_logs)
        return er

    table = next((t for t in tables if isinstance(t, dict) and t.get("table_id") == table_id), None)
    if not table:
        er = _err("NOT_FOUND", "table_id not found", field="table_id")
        _append_log(op_logs, "unknown", table_id, er, False, err_code="ResourceNotFoundException", err_msg=er["error"]["message"], rcu=1.0)
        _save("ddb_operation_logs.json", op_logs)
        return er

    if not isinstance(attributes, dict):
        er = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "attributes must be an object", field="attributes")
        _append_log(op_logs, table.get("account_id"), table_id, er, False, err_code="ValidationException", err_msg=er["error"]["message"])
        _save("ddb_operation_logs.json", op_logs)
        return er

    # exactly one of pk_s/pk_n/pk_b
    pk_vals = [("S", pk_s), ("N", pk_n), ("B", pk_b)]
    pk_present = [(t, v) for t, v in pk_vals if v is not None]
    if len(pk_present) != 1:
        er = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "must provide exactly one of pk_s, pk_n, pk_b", field="pk_s")
        _append_log(op_logs, table.get("account_id"), table_id, er, False, err_code="ValidationException", err_msg=er["error"]["message"])
        _save("ddb_operation_logs.json", op_logs)
        return er
    pk_type, pk_val = pk_present[0]
    if pk_type == "N":
        if (not isinstance(pk_val, (int, float))) or isinstance(pk_val, bool):
            er = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "pk_n must be a number", field="pk_n")
            _append_log(op_logs, table.get("account_id"), table_id, er, False, err_code="ValidationException", err_msg=er["error"]["message"])
            _save("ddb_operation_logs.json", op_logs)
            return er
        if isinstance(pk_val, float) and (math.isnan(pk_val) or math.isinf(pk_val)):
            er = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "pk_n must be a finite number", field="pk_n")
            _append_log(op_logs, table.get("account_id"), table_id, er, False, err_code="ValidationException", err_msg=er["error"]["message"])
            _save("ddb_operation_logs.json", op_logs)
            return er
        pk_val = float(pk_val)
    else:
        if not isinstance(pk_val, str):
            er = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", f"pk_{pk_type.lower()} must be a string", field=f"pk_{pk_type.lower()}")
            _append_log(op_logs, table.get("account_id"), table_id, er, False, err_code="ValidationException", err_msg=er["error"]["message"])
            _save("ddb_operation_logs.json", op_logs)
            return er

    has_sort_key = table.get("range_key_name") is not None
    sk_present = [(t, v) for t, v in (("S", sk_s), ("N", sk_n), ("B", sk_b)) if v is not None]
    if has_sort_key and len(sk_present) != 1:
        er = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "must provide exactly one sort key value (sk_s, sk_n, sk_b) for tables with a sort key", field="sk_s")
        _append_log(op_logs, table.get("account_id"), table_id, er, False, err_code="ValidationException", err_msg=er["error"]["message"])
        _save("ddb_operation_logs.json", op_logs)
        return er
    if (not has_sort_key) and len(sk_present) != 0:
        er = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "must not provide sort key values for tables without a sort key", field="sk_s")
        _append_log(op_logs, table.get("account_id"), table_id, er, False, err_code="ValidationException", err_msg=er["error"]["message"])
        _save("ddb_operation_logs.json", op_logs)
        return er

    sk_type, sk_val = (None, None)
    if has_sort_key:
        sk_type, sk_val = sk_present[0]
        if sk_type == "N":
            if (not isinstance(sk_val, (int, float))) or isinstance(sk_val, bool):
                er = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "sk_n must be a number", field="sk_n")
                _append_log(op_logs, table.get("account_id"), table_id, er, False, err_code="ValidationException", err_msg=er["error"]["message"])
                _save("ddb_operation_logs.json", op_logs)
                return er
            if isinstance(sk_val, float) and (math.isnan(sk_val) or math.isinf(sk_val)):
                er = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "sk_n must be a finite number", field="sk_n")
                _append_log(op_logs, table.get("account_id"), table_id, er, False, err_code="ValidationException", err_msg=er["error"]["message"])
                _save("ddb_operation_logs.json", op_logs)
                return er
            sk_val = float(sk_val)
        else:
            if not isinstance(sk_val, str):
                er = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", f"sk_{sk_type.lower()} must be a string", field=f"sk_{sk_type.lower()}")
                _append_log(op_logs, table.get("account_id"), table_id, er, False, err_code="ValidationException", err_msg=er["error"]["message"])
                _save("ddb_operation_logs.json", op_logs)
                return er

    # Match schema types
    if pk_type != table.get("hash_key_type"):
        er = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "partition key type does not match table hash_key_type", field="pk_s")
        _append_log(op_logs, table.get("account_id"), table_id, er, False, err_code="ValidationException", err_msg=er["error"]["message"])
        _save("ddb_operation_logs.json", op_logs)
        return er
    if has_sort_key and sk_type != table.get("range_key_type"):
        er = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "sort key type does not match table range_key_type", field="sk_s")
        _append_log(op_logs, table.get("account_id"), table_id, er, False, err_code="ValidationException", err_msg=er["error"]["message"])
        _save("ddb_operation_logs.json", op_logs)
        return er

    # Locate item (must exist and be ACTIVE)
    pk_field = {"S": "pk_s", "N": "pk_n", "B": "pk_b"}[pk_type]
    sk_field = {"S": "sk_s", "N": "sk_n", "B": "sk_b"}[sk_type] if has_sort_key else None

    target_idx = None
    for i, it in enumerate(items):
        if not isinstance(it, dict):
            continue
        if it.get("table_id") != table_id:
            continue
        if it.get("status") != "ACTIVE":
            continue
        if it.get(pk_field) != pk_val:
            continue
        # ensure other pk fields null
        bad = False
        for f in ("pk_s", "pk_n", "pk_b"):
            if f != pk_field and it.get(f) is not None:
                bad = True; break
        if bad:
            continue
        if has_sort_key:
            if it.get(sk_field) != sk_val:
                continue
            for f in ("sk_s", "sk_n", "sk_b"):
                if f != sk_field and it.get(f) is not None:
                    bad = True; break
            if bad:
                continue
        else:
            if any(it.get(f) is not None for f in ("sk_s", "sk_n", "sk_b")):
                continue
        target_idx = i
        break

    if target_idx is None:
        er = _err("NOT_FOUND", "item not found", field="pk_s")
        _append_log(op_logs, table.get("account_id"), table_id, er, False, err_code="ResourceNotFoundException", err_msg=er["error"]["message"], rcu=1.0)
        _save("ddb_operation_logs.json", op_logs)
        return er

    item = items[target_idx]
    old_item = json.loads(json.dumps(item))  # deep copy

    if expected_version is not None:
        if not isinstance(expected_version, int) or isinstance(expected_version, bool) or expected_version < 0:
            er = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "expected_version must be an integer >= 0", field="expected_version")
            _append_log(op_logs, table.get("account_id"), table_id, er, False, err_code="ValidationException", err_msg=er["error"]["message"])
            _save("ddb_operation_logs.json", op_logs)
            return er
        if int(item.get("version") or 0) != expected_version:
            er = _err("CONFLICT", "version precondition failed", expected_version=expected_version, actual_version=item.get("version"))
            _append_log(op_logs, table.get("account_id"), table_id, er, False, err_code="ConditionalCheckFailedException", err_msg="ConditionalCheckFailedException: version mismatch", rcu=1.0)
            _save("ddb_operation_logs.json", op_logs)
            return er

    # Merge attributes
    current_attrs = item.get("attributes") if isinstance(item.get("attributes"), dict) else {}
    new_attrs = dict(current_attrs)
    new_attrs.update(attributes)

    sha = _canon_sha256(new_attrs)
    if sha is None or not re.match(r"^[a-f0-9]{64}$", sha):
        er = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "attributes must be JSON-serializable; could not compute attributes_sha256", field="attributes")
        _append_log(op_logs, table.get("account_id"), table_id, er, False, err_code="ValidationException", err_msg=er["error"]["message"])
        _save("ddb_operation_logs.json", op_logs)
        return er

    item["attributes"] = new_attrs
    item["attributes_sha256"] = sha
    item["version"] = int(item.get("version") or 0) + 1 if int(item.get("version") or 0) >= 1 else 1
    item["updated_at"] = now
    items[target_idx] = item
    _save("ddb_items.json", items)

    if return_values is None:
        return_values = "ALL_NEW"
    if return_values not in ("NONE", "ALL_NEW", "ALL_OLD"):
        er = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "return_values must be NONE, ALL_NEW, or ALL_OLD", field="return_values")
        _append_log(op_logs, table.get("account_id"), table_id, er, False, err_code="ValidationException", err_msg=er["error"]["message"], rcu=1.0)
        _save("ddb_operation_logs.json", op_logs)
        return er

    resp = {"attributes": None}
    if return_values == "ALL_NEW":
        resp["attributes"] = item
    elif return_values == "ALL_OLD":
        resp["attributes"] = old_item

    _append_log(op_logs, table.get("account_id"), table_id, resp, True, rcu=1.0, wcu=1.0)
    _save("ddb_operation_logs.json", op_logs)
    return resp
